body: Owner, 2026-09-30: build every way to store and check sessions, each pluggable so an app can add its own. Database sessions stay the default. Stateless (self-contained encrypted) sessions are opt-in; this narrows the 2026-09-16 decision 'opaque token, revocable, no JWT-as-session' to the default only. Also resumes the held per-client session lifetime task.
title: Sessions are pluggable: every storage and caching strategy, stateless included
